attacks.name: Unarmed Strike
attacks.notes: Martial Arts: bonus-action strike after attacking

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.desc: Without armor or shield, AC = 10 + DEX + WIS.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.desc: Use DEX for unarmed strikes and monk weapons, roll your Martial Arts die for damage, and make an unarmed strike as a bonus action after attacking.

features.name: Ki
features.desc: Spend ki for Flurry of Blows (two bonus unarmed strikes), Patient Defense (Dodge as bonus action) or Step of the Wind (Dash/Disengage as bonus action, double jump).

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.desc: Speed increases while not wearing armor or a shield; at 9th, move along walls and water.

features.name: Deflect Missiles
features.desc: Reaction: reduce ranged weapon damage by 1d10 + DEX + monk level; spend 1 ki to throw it back.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.desc: Reaction: reduce falling damage by 5 × monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.desc: Spend 1 ki on a melee hit: target makes a CON save or is stunned until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Draconic Disciple
features.desc: Unarmed strikes can deal draconic damage; reroll failed CHA checks; learn Draconic.

features.name: Breath of the Dragon
features.desc: Replace an attack with a 20 ft cone or 30 ft line of elemental breath (DEX half).

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.desc: Replace one attack: 15 ft cone, 1d10 (scales at 5th, 11th, 17th), DEX save.

features.name: Metallic Breath Weapon
features.desc: At 5th level: a second breath — Enervating (incapacitate) or Repulsion (push and prone), once per long rest.

features.name: Wanderer
features.desc: You remember the lay of any land you have crossed — roads, landmarks, rivers and settlements — and can sketch a rough map of it from memory. Where the wilds offer berries, game and fresh water, you can forage enough each day to feed yourself and up to five companions.

features.name: Crusher
features.desc: +1 STR or CON; push targets 5 ft with bludgeoning hits; crits grant advantage to allies.

inventory.name: Coiling Grasp Tattoo
inventory.summary: Action: inky tendrils hit a creature within 15 ft — DC 14 STR save or 3d6 force and grappled (escape DC 14).

hb.rollNote: force damage on a failed save, and the creature is grappled
hb.text: Inky tendrils reach a creature you can see within 15 ft. It escapes with an action and a DC 14 STR (Athletics) or DEX (Acrobatics) check; the grapple also ends if it gets more than 15 ft away or you use the tattoo on someone else.

inventory.name: Torch
inventory.summary: 1 hour of bright light 20 ft; 1 fire damage as a weapon

action.name: Dash
action.text: Gain extra movement equal to your speed.

action.name: Disengage
action.text: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks this turn.

action.name: Dodge
action.text: Attacks against you have disadvantage; advantage on DEX saves until your next turn.

action.name: Help
action.text: Give an ally advantage on a check or their next attack.

action.name: Hide
action.text: Make a Stealth check to hide.

action.name: Ready
action.text: Choose a trigger and a reaction to take.

action.name: Search
action.text: Make a Perception or Investigation check.

action.name: Use an Object
action.text: Interact with a second object or use an item.

action.name: Grapple
action.text: Athletics vs the target's Athletics or Acrobatics; its speed becomes 0.

action.name: Shove
action.text: Athletics contest to push 5 ft or knock prone.

reaction.name: Opportunity Attack
reaction.text: When a hostile creature you can see leaves your reach, make one melee attack.

move.name: Interact
move.text: Draw a weapon, open a door, pick up an item — one free interaction.

move.name: Climb / swim
move.text: Each foot costs 1 extra foot unless you have the speed.

move.name: Jump
move.text: Long jump = STR score in feet with a 10 ft run.
